meta.name: qin-standardization-system
meta.description: Use when implementing uniform standards across a newly unified empire. Covers weights and measures (衡石丈尺), writing system (书同文字), transportation (车同轨), Five Elements cosmology, and symbolic renaming of rivers and populace.

copy.tagline: 统一度量衡、文字与交通标准
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为统一后的帝国建立标准化体系。
copy.tagline_en: Standardize weights, writing, and transport across a unified empire.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to establish uniform standards across a newly unified empire.

howto.what: 装上后，当你要为一个新统一的国家制定统一标准时，Claude 会按照秦朝制度逐步实施：统一度量衡、文字、车轨，应用五行理论（水德、尚黑、用六），并更改河流和百姓的称呼。
howto.when: 当你描述一个刚统一的帝国或要求实施统一标准时触发，例如提到‘统一度量衡’、‘书同文’等关键词。

say.text: 帮我统一新帝国的度量衡和文字。
say.note: Claude 将执行步骤 1 和 2。

say.text: 按秦朝制度制定五行色彩和数字。
say.note: Claude 将设定水德、黑色、数字 6 等。

howto.what_en: When you need to implement uniform standards for a newly unified empire, Claude will follow the Qin standardization procedure: unify weights, measures, script, axle width; apply Five Elements theory (Water virtue, black, number 6); rename rivers and populace.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you describe a newly unified empire or request standardization, e.g., mention 'unify weights and measures' or 'standardize script'.

say_en.text: Standardize weights, measures, and script for my new empire.
Apply Qin Five Elements theory: water, black, number 6.
say_en.note: Claude will set calendar, color, and sacred number.
